title: Recognition for Contributions of SAF Personnel Involved in Recent Repatriation Flights from Middle East
what_it_is: Recognition for Contributions of SAF Personnel Involved in Recent Repatriation Flights from Middle East

sections.label: Recognising SAF repatriation mission contributions
sections.summary: The Ministry will consider formally recognising SAF personnel in recent Middle East repatriation flights and developing public education initiatives on the mission.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
sentences.text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence whether the Ministry will consider (i) formally recognising the contributions of SAF personnel involved in recent repatriation flights from the Middle East and (ii) developing exhibitions or public education initiatives to highlight the choices and personal courage required to organise such repatriation efforts from active warzones.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We will similarly do so for the recent mission undertaken by the SAF in service of our nation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Within the bounds of operational security, the SAF will profile the mission planning, execution and the background training that enabled the SAF to execute this mission.

sections.label: Teams behind repatriation flights
sections.summary: Air crew were supported by planners, analysts, policy staff, a military medical team, defence partner personnel and Full-time National Servicemen.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Besides the air crew who mounted the flights, there was also a team of headquarter planners, intelligence analysts and policy staff, some of whom are non-uniform officers, who worked at short notice to develop a safe flight plan, obtain diplomatic clearances and formulate various contingency scenarios and responses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We had a military medical team deployed to ensure the safety and well-being of those on board, commercial personnel from our defence partners, including ST Engineering Defence Aviation Services and ST Airport Services, deployed alongside our uniform engineers to support aircraft maintenance and cargo management.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Locally, our Full-time National Servicemen ensure that the aircraft was prepared and equipped in a timely manner for the two flights.

sections.label: Commending personnel and sharing lessons
sections.summary: The team will be commended, debriefed and lessons shared with servicemen, and some work shared with the public.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: And I state on record again, these men and women should be immensely commended.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: We intend, like in any operation, to debrief the team thoroughly and then we will share the relevant lessons with our servicemen, including those that may not be made publicly available.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: On his other question about sharing some of these facets of the work with the wider public, we will certainly do so as we have done so in the first tranche with the media, including our local newspapers and broadcast media, to highlight some of the work that is done behind the scenes to enable this mission.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: For the SAF to be able to mount an operation successfully, even if it is one minute on the stage, it requires 10 years of hard work behind the stage.
